### What is the Water Cycle?
The water cycle is the continuous movement of water on, above, and below the surface of the Earth. Driven primarily by solar energy (the sun) and gravity, this cycle ensures that water is constantly recycled. There is no "end" to the cycle; water evaporates, condenses, precipitates, and collects, only to start the process again.

This is the starting point of the cycle you described. The sun provides the thermal energy necessary to turn liquid water into water vapor (a gas).
